title: Google Ads for Dentists | Zero Commission

facts.fact: Remedo's page headline claims its dental Google Ads can deliver 3X patient volume.
facts.quote: # 3X Patient Volume with Dental Google Ads

facts.fact: The page states that when managed effectively, dental Google Ads campaigns can achieve conversion rates around 9%; the page does not attribute this figure to a named source.
facts.quote: When managed effectively, dental Google Ads campaigns can achieve conversion rates around 9%, with potential ROI ranging from 300% to 500%.

facts.fact: The page states that when managed effectively, dental Google Ads campaigns have potential ROI ranging from 300% to 500%; the page does not attribute this figure to a named source.

facts.fact: Remedo's page includes a banner stating '2X your dental patients now' as a marketing claim.
Remedo offers a free consultation that its page associates with a value of $500.
Remedo's page offers a free 1-hour strategy discussion.
Remedo's page advertises a zero-commission model for its dental Google Ads services.
Remedo's page states that clients only pay for their Google Ad spend, with the ad budget being the only cost described.
facts.quote: You only pay what you spend

facts.fact: Remedo's page offers a 'Get Started for FREE' call to action, with no price for the service stated.
